messages.adobe.connection.auth-help: The official Adobe IMS UserInfo call requires client_id. Enter api-key|access-token. A token alone may work, but usually returns 401.
messages.adobe.guide.token-note: Use an Adobe IMS user access token. In most cases you also need a Client ID.
messages.adobe.oauth.note: Enable User Authentication in Adobe Console. Product API permissions depend on the approved scope of the app.
